title: Match a résumé without inventing experience
goal: Find evidence gaps between a fictional résumé and a role description.
explanation: Hiring systems vary; keyword matching is not a complete model of an applicant-tracking system. Optimizing wording must never fabricate skills, experience or results. This activity produces a gap ledger and an honest revision, not a promise of passing screening or getting hired.
sampleInput: Role: support coordinator; requires ticket triage, clear customer writing, spreadsheet reporting, escalation and teamwork. Fictional résumé: “Answered community questions. Kept a weekly list of requests in a spreadsheet. Asked the coordinator to handle unresolved cases.” No paid employment, specific software certification or numerical results are supplied.
prompt: Map each role requirement to an exact résumé quote, or mark No evidence. Suggest clearer truthful wording only where evidence exists. List skills to learn separately. Do not add years, credentials, tool expertise or performance numbers. Do not predict an ATS score or hiring outcome.
workedExample: Spreadsheet reporting has partial evidence in the weekly request list. Escalation has evidence in referring unresolved cases. A claim such as “Reduced ticket backlog by 40% using Zendesk” has no support and must not appear.

steps.title: Use fictional material
steps.text: Keep personal identifiers and real employment documents out of the exercise.

steps.title: Build the gap ledger
steps.text: For each requirement, record exact evidence, partial evidence or no evidence.

steps.title: Draft honest wording
steps.text: Improve clarity for one supported bullet without inventing a metric or qualification.

steps.title: Inspect a tempting invention
steps.text: Ask whether a numerical result or tool name appeared despite being absent from the fixture.

steps.title: Plan a real learning step
steps.text: Choose one genuine gap and define a small project that could create evidence later.

checks: Every revised claim traces to a fixture quote or is explicitly labelled a future learning goal.
No unsupported numbers, software expertise or credentials appear.
The result avoids promises about ATS ranking or hiring success.
commonMistakes: Claiming all screening systems use the same scoring rules.
offline: Highlight evidence manually and rewrite one truthful bullet; score it against the same role requirements.
reflection: Which missing keyword represented a real skill gap rather than a wording problem?

evidence.title: Keep the build
evidence.detail: Save your original input, exact prompt and resulting artifact. Every revised claim traces to a fixture quote or is explicitly labelled a future learning goal.

evidence.title: Show what you tested
evidence.detail: Record a pass/fail result and evidence for every check below. No unsupported numbers, software expertise or credentials appear.

evidence.title: Explain a limitation
evidence.detail: Write what changed after one deliberate revision and name a remaining failure mode. Keyword stuffing without evidence.
